highlights: Mouse orbit speed: Preferences > Input slows the mouse or trackpad turn (0.1x to 2x) if the view spins too fast (thanks hullalmiah on Discord)
Symmetry with textured brushes: Dragon Scales, Skin Pores, Wood Grain and other stamp brushes mirror exactly under X symmetry (#197)
Crisp Flatten only cuts: it never adds clay, and pen pressure no longer changes how deep it cuts (thanks Hameron on Discord)
Two-key shortcuts also work with both keys pressed together, and brush Size keeps its value at the canvas edge
